name: WECA SATN community centroids and connections

metadata.source_boundary_dataset: ONS Built Up Areas (December 2022) Boundaries GB BGG
metadata.notes: SATN-style community centroids derived from ONS built-up-area centroids plus explicit city-village centroids. Connector lines are generated as a non-crossing minimum spanning tree.
